disease_label_per_paper: MPO-ANCA-positive microscopic polyangiitis following COVID-19 infection
presentation_summary: Intermittent fever over 38 C, malaise, 8 kg weight loss over 2 months, and bilateral gastrocnemius myalgia/tenderness after prior COVID-19 infection
Infectious cause was excluded by blood cultures and imaging, and empiric tazobactam/piperacillin was ineffective
On transfer, vital signs showed mild fever 37.5 C and tachycardia 117/min
CRP was 13.6 mg/dL, MPO-ANCA was 61.9 U/mL, albumin was 2.9 g/dL, and urinalysis showed glomerular hematuria with RBC casts and mild proteinuria
Renal biopsy later showed pauci-immune necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis, supporting MPA

risk_context.source_text_value: three months prior to admission, PCR testing was positive for COVID-19

observations.quality_note: lower-bound numeric encoding of reported maximum temperature >38 C

observations.source_text_value: urinalysis showed positive blood (2+) and urinary sediment RBC 10-19/high power field
granular casts 5-9/whole field and RBC casts 1-4/whole field
infectious cause was excluded by blood cultures

confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: renal biopsy revealed cellular crescents, capillary loop necrosis, pauci-immune type immunofluorescence, tubulitis, peritubular capillaritis, and vascular wall destruction with fibrinoid necrosis

quality_warnings: Renal biopsy is stored as confirmatory_findings rather than primary observations to avoid making the ranking trivially pathology-driven.
